security.//: connect-src MUST admit tauri's ipc transport (invoke() is a fetch to ipc://localhost, http://ipc.localhost on windows). without it every runtime_call is blocked by the webview's own csp and the window reports the runtime unreachable while the runtime is running fine.
security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:
